name: How do I choose the right contractor for my kitchen addition project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my kitchen addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right contractor involves evaluating their experience, portfolio of similar projects, references, and understanding of your vision. Look for a licensed and insured company with strong communication practices and a clear process for project management. Review their past work, client testimonials, and ensure they have a proven track record in luxury home additions. A good contractor will provide detailed proposals and be transparent about costs and timelines.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience, strong references, clear communication, and a portfolio of similar luxury additions.
